metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from quadbio: single-cell and spatial genomics analysis, research code and task handover, and working on ETH Zurich's Euler cluster.

plugins.name: analysis-workflow
plugins.description: Conventions, guard hooks and a small package for analysis repos where humans (notebooks) and coding agents (scripts) work side by side.

plugins.name: cell-type-annotation
plugins.description: Evidence-driven, project-agnostic cell-type annotation of pre-clustered single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data.

plugins.name: euler-hpc
plugins.description: Run coding agents on ETH Zurich's Euler cluster: node, allocation, storage rules and your setup at session start; a skill for Slurm jobs, software and data; jobs listed by session.

plugins.name: research-agent-skills
plugins.description: How agents write research code, run and hand over research tasks, and set up a project so Claude Code and Codex read the same instructions.

plugins.name: sci-figures
plugins.description: Nature-style research figures and their legends: outline, layout and visual conventions, export to editable PDFs, legend writing and independent reviews.
